method_facts.documented_method_fact: Intrinsic value is an estimate of discounted extractable future cash. Owner earnings require maintenance investment and necessary working capital, with estimation uncertainty.

method_facts.documented_method_fact: Retained capital and repurchases need economic justification. Repurchase effects depend on price versus intrinsic value and underlying earnings, not share-count reduction alone.

method_facts.documented_method_fact: Preserve financing strength and liquidity appropriate to liabilities. Working liquidity, an absolute minimum and a purpose-specific repurchase condition are distinct constraints.
